records.jp: リーダー、勉強会のこと忘れてた？<CR>前回クイーンを倒して、帰って来た時話したでしょ
records.en_original: Did you forget about the study group, Leader? We talked about it after we beat the Queen last time, remember?
records.en: Did you forget about the study group, Leader? We talked about it after we beat the Queen last time, remember?

records.jp: ベテランのリーダーに、<CR>異灰との戦い方を色々教えてもらおう、って
records.en_original: Since you're such a seasoned leader, I wanted you to show us more tips for fighting the Testa.
records.en: Since you're such a seasoned leader, I wanted you to show us more tips for fighting the Testa.

records.jp: ……勉強会、するんでしょう？
records.en_original: ...We're having a study session, right?
records.en: ...We're having a study session, right?

records.jp: ……ち、違う。<CR>詩帆が楽しみにしてて、しつこく誘うから
records.en_original: No, that's not it! Shiho kept bugging me about it—she was really looking forward to it.
records.en: No, that's not it! Shiho kept bugging me about it—she was really looking forward to it.

records.jp: ええっ？　わたしそんなにしつこく誘ったかなぁ？<CR>むしろ森崎さんの方が――
records.en_original: What? Was I really that pushy? I think you were way more—
records.en: What? Was I really that pushy? I think you were way more—

records.jp: ……うるさい黙って
records.en_original: Quiet, Shiho. Just shut it.
records.en: Quiet, Shiho. Just shut it.

records.jp: えー……
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 勉強会といっても、４人しかいないけどね～。<CR>かんなも誘ったんだけど、あの子勉強アレルギーだから
records.en_original: Even if we call it a study session, it's just the four of us. I tried inviting Kanna, too, but that girl's allergic to studying.
records.en: Even if we call it a study session, it's just the four of us. I tried inviting Kanna, too, but that girl's allergic to studying.

records.jp: メイは日直の仕事が終わり次第来るって。<CR>もう少し待ってれば――
records.en_original: Mei said she'll come as soon as she's done with her class rep duties. If we wait a little longer...
records.en: Mei said she'll come as soon as she's done with her class rep duties. If we wait a little longer...

records.jp: ちょっと！<CR>何勝手に部外者が、部室占拠してんの！
records.en_original: Hey! What's a non-member doing hogging the clubroom?!
records.en: Hey! What's a non-member doing hogging the clubroom?!

records.jp: 安住……さん？
records.en_original: Nanaka?
records.en: Nanaka?

records.jp: あんた、部員じゃないでしょ？<CR>出てって、って何度も言ってんじゃん
records.en_original: You're not even a member, are you? I've told you to leave so many times already.
records.en: You're not even a member, are you? I've told you to leave so many times already.

records.jp: ……いい加減、現実を見たら？
records.en_original: It's about time you faced reality, don't you think?
records.en: It's about time you faced reality, don't you think?

records.jp: リーダーは、もう私たちのリーダーなの。<CR>いつまで現実逃避し続けるつもり？
records.en_original: He's our leader now. How long are you going to keep running away from reality?
records.en: He's our leader now. How long are you going to keep running away from reality?

records.jp: それと私、貴方のやり方はあまり好きじゃない。<CR>いつまでも樹里に負い目を感じてないで――
records.en_original: And honestly, I don't really like your way of doing things. Stop carrying all that guilt over Juri already—
records.en: And honestly, I don't really like your way of doing things. Stop carrying all that guilt over Juri already—

records.jp: 樹里は関係ない！
records.en_original: Juri has nothing to do with this!
records.en: Juri has nothing to do with this!

records.jp: 樹里さんって……
records.en_original: Juri...?
records.en: Juri...?

records.jp: この前話した……転校した子。<CR>菜々花のバディだったんだ
records.en_original: We talked about her before... She's the girl who transferred out. Nanaka used to be her partner.
records.en: We talked about her before... She's the girl who transferred out. Nanaka used to be her partner.

records.jp: わたしはあんたと違って、冷たい人間じゃないの！
records.en_original: I'm not cold and heartless like you!
records.en: I'm not cold and heartless like you!

records.jp: ……最悪。もう帰る
records.en_original: ...Whatever. I'm going home.
records.en: ...Whatever. I'm going home.

records.jp: 「出動しなかった理由を聞かせてほしい」
records.en_original: I want to know why you didn't go out on the mission.
records.en: I want to know why you didn't go out on the mission.

records.jp: ……やめてよ
records.en_original: ...Just stop.
records.en: ...Just stop.

records.jp: あんたがそうやって先に進めば進むほど――
records.en_original: The further ahead you keep moving, the more—
records.en: The further ahead you keep moving, the more—

records.jp: ……こんなこと、あんたに言っても意味ない
records.en_original: ...It's pointless even saying this to you.
records.en: ...It's pointless even saying this to you.

records.jp: ……なーなも、ちゃんとわかっている
records.en_original: Nana understands it all, too.
records.en: Nana understands it all, too.

records.jp: なーなの出動が地域を守るためにも、<CR>みんなを死なせないためにも、必要なことは
records.en_original: She knows that her joining the fight is necessary to protect the region and to keep everyone safe.
records.en: She knows that her joining the fight is necessary to protect the region and to keep everyone safe.

records.jp: それでも、できない理由があるのだ。<CR>それだけは、勘違いしないでほしい
records.en_original: Even so, there's a reason she can't do it. Just...don't get the wrong idea about that.
records.en: Even so, there's a reason she can't do it. Just...don't get the wrong idea about that.

records.jp: ……なーな
records.en_original: ...Nana.
records.en: ...Nana.

records.jp: きらら？<CR>どうしたの、こんな所まで来て
records.en_original: Kirara? What are you doing all the way out here?
records.en: Kirara? What are you doing all the way out here?

records.jp: もうやめよう
records.en_original: Let's stop.
records.en: Let's stop.

records.jp: ……何が？
records.en_original: ...Stop what?
records.en: ...Stop what?

records.jp: きららは、なーなの足手まといになったりしない。<CR>だからもう、ちゃんと出動しよう
records.en_original: I'm not going to hold you back, Nana. So let's start fighting for real.
records.en: I'm not going to hold you back, Nana. So let's start fighting for real.

records.jp: しない
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: きららもちゃんと戦いたいし、<CR>なーなの役に立ちたい――
records.en_original: I really want to fight too, and I want to help you—
records.en: I really want to fight too, and I want to help you—

records.jp: しないってば！<CR>わたし、他にやることがあるから
records.en_original: I said no! I have other things I need to do.
records.en: I said no! I have other things I need to do.

records.jp: やることって？
records.en_original: Other things? Like what?
records.en: Other things? Like what?

records.jp: なーな、最近図書室で何を調べてるの？
records.en_original: Nana, what have you been researching in the library lately?
records.en: Nana, what have you been researching in the library lately?

records.jp: きららには関係ない
records.en_original: It has nothing to do with you.
records.en: It has nothing to do with you.

records.jp: なくない。バディだから
records.en_original: Yes it does. We're partners, aren't we?
records.en: Yes it does. We're partners, aren't we?

records.jp: ……これは、わたしが解決しないといけないことなの。<CR>お願い、放っておいて
records.en_original: This is something I have to solve myself. Please, just leave me alone.
records.en: This is something I have to solve myself. Please, just leave me alone.
